page: Google Cloud Platform c3-standard-22-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this server features 22 vCPUs mapped to 11 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 88 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per vCPU. The hardware configuration includes 1608 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across four local drives, while no GPU accelerators are present.

Performance benchmarks indicate solid mid-tier capabilities. The CPU operates at a base speed of 2.7 GHz, supported by a 105 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). In synthetic testing, the instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 12136.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 28697.69. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only cached small block speed of 1499.45 GB/sec, which drops to 109.64 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Notably, the server demonstrates strong performance in LLM text generation with a small 135M model, reaching 293.95 tokens per second, while maintaining average performance for larger models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c3-standard-22-lssd balances dedicated compute resources with high-speed, local NVMe storage. This resource density makes it highly suitable for workloads requiring fast local read/write operations without the overhead of network-attached storage. Appropriate workloads include database operations, software compilation, static web serving, and moderate-scale language model inference.
